approve(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-approve}. NOTE: If `value` is the maximum `uint256`, the allowance is not updated on `transferFrom`. This is semantically equivalent to an infinite approval. Requirements: - `spender` cannot be the zero address.

cancelOwnershipHandover().details: Cancels the two-step ownership handover to the caller, if any.

transfer(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transfer}. Requirements: - `to` cannot be the zero address. - the caller must have a balance of at least `value`.

params._receiver: The address to receive the assets.

requestOwnershipHandover().details: Request a two-step ownership handover to the caller. The request will automatically expire in 48 hours (172800 seconds) by default.

transferOwnership(address).details: Allows the owner to transfer the ownership to `newOwner`.

params._bps: New weekly withdraw share basis points

upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes).details: Upgrade the implementation of the proxy to `newImplementation`, and subsequently execute the function call encoded in `data`. Calls {_authorizeUpgrade}. Emits an {Upgraded} event.

params._bps: New share CLever strategy basis points

setCleverCvxStrategyShare(uint16).details: Staked CVX share is automatically `100% - clevStrategyShareBps`

completeOwnershipHandover(address).details: Allows the owner to complete the two-step ownership handover to `pendingOwner`. Reverts if there is no existing ownership handover requested by `pendingOwner`.

params._minAmountOut: Minimum amount of clevCVX to receive from swapping CVX
params._swapPercentage: The percentage of `_cleverDeposit` to swap to clevCVX, remaining assets will be deposited to Locker
params._maxCleverDeposit: The maximum amount of CVX to deposit into Clever. The remaining will stay idle in this contract

distribute(uint256,uint256,uint256).details: If `_swapPercentage > 0`, must call through a private RPC to avoid getting sandwiched, as totalAssets will spike

ownershipHandoverExpiresAt(address).details: Returns the expiry timestamp for the two-step ownership handover to `pendingOwner`.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transferFrom}. Emits an {Approval} event indicating the updated allowance. This is not required by the EIP. See the note at the beginning of {ERC20}. NOTE: Does not update the allowance if the current allowance is the maximum `uint256`. Requirements: - `from` and `to` cannot be the zero address. - `from` must have a balance of at least `value`. - the caller must have allowance for ``from``'s tokens of at least `value`.

params._shares: The amount of shares to burn

requestUnlock(uint256,address,address).details: Withdrawal fee is not charged, but CLever repayment fee is charged

returns._assets: The amount of assets that will be unlocked
returns._unlockEpoch: The epoch number when unlocked assets can be withdrawn

permit(address,address,uint256,uint256,u.details: Sets `value` as the allowance of `spender` over ``owner``'s tokens, given ``owner``'s signed approval. IMPORTANT: The same issues {IERC20-approve} has related to transaction ordering also apply here. Emits an {Approval} event. Requirements: - `spender` cannot be the zero address. - `deadline` must be a timestamp in the future. - `v`, `r` and `s` must be a valid `secp256k1` signature from `owner` over the EIP712-formatted function arguments. - the signature must use ``owner``'s current nonce (see {nonces}). selectedFunctions.label: Asymmetry Finance Deposit CVX
warnings: Static deployed source/ABI inventory only, not fresh RPC/storage/runtime identity, liquidity/backing, successful-transaction or financial-safety assurance. Grants, canonical calldata/value checks, balances, allowances, pauses and independent controls remain mandatory; all admitted calls require zero native value.

Ethereum mainnet afCVX ERC1967 proxy 0x8668a15b7b023Dc77B372a740FCb8939E15257Cf currently resolves via Sourcify and Etherscan to AfCvx implementation 0x56664FFcCfF6BB282CcA96808AF03d9042e1f799, not stale official-doc implementation 0x87e670b71958d39113b7961dd016ec198ad82c03. Current implementation hardcodes 18-decimal CVX 0x4e3FBD56CD56c3e72c1403e103b45Db9da5B9D2B and afCVX shares are18 decimals. No safETH or legacy USDaf deployment is admitted.

deposit/mint pull caller CVX with allowance to afCVX and credit receiver shares; assets use CVX atoms, shares use afCVX atoms. withdraw/redeem pay explicit receiver and burn owner shares; non-owner caller needs existing share allowance. No permit, approval, transfer, arbitrary zap or role operation admitted.

Instant withdraw/redeem are cash- and shared-weeklyWithdrawalLimit-constrained and otherwise revert; no queue is created by these calls. They can unstake from fixed Convex RewardsPool if idle CVX is insufficient, but cannot instantly unlock the CLever portion. The remaining budget does not automatically refill merely because a week elapsed: operator/owner harvest calls _updateWeeklyWithdrawalLimit at/after withdrawalLimitNextUpdate, setting totalAssets*weeklyWithdrawalShareBps/10000 for another seven days.

Official guide advertises3% instant fee and25% weekly access, but actual withdrawalFeeBps/weeklyWithdrawalShareBps are owner-mutable and not asserted current. Fees are mathematically applied as gross-assets = requested-net-assets + ceil(net-assets*feeBps/10000); redeem subtracts ceil(gross*feeBps/(10000+feeBps)). Owner may configure withdrawal/performance fees or share splits up to10000bp. Fee remains accounted to vault holders; harvest performance fee is paid to protocolFeeCollector. Deposit/redeem conversions round down, mint/withdraw round up.

requestUnlock(shares,receiver,owner) burns shares immediately, needs share allowance if caller!=owner, books CVX obligations under receiver in the fixed CLever strategy and returns final unlock epoch plus assets. It is not an immediate payout and has no admitted cancellation. No afCVX withdrawal fee applies, but CLever repayment fees are reflected in strategy net accounting/unlock capacity. Requests can fail during strategy maintenance windows or unlockInProgress, or if capacity is insufficient.

withdrawUnlocked(receiver) is permissionless trigger of the matured requests already booked for that receiver; funds go to that same receiver, not caller. It cannot redirect another receiver claim. Claims scan matured weekly epochs (timestamp/one week), can return0 before maturity, and depend on actual strategy/CLever cash and successful locker withdrawal. Allocations across future unlock epochs and operator maintenance determine delay; no fixed instant settlement promise.

The afCVX implementation constructor immutably binds strategy proxy 0xB828a33aF42ab2e8908DfA8C2470850db7e4Fd2a, currently resolved to 0xD0F77441B70c84aa3366a9F79F2fD16618739aB0, not stale docs strategy implementation0x98f3f4ba1bbcd4fa3d7caf1eb88d93cd628cff02. Strategy constructor manager is afCVX proxy; requests/claims call only that manager. Vault and strategy remain owner-upgradeable and operator-managed, with mutable pause, fees, withdrawal share, allocation and operator settings. Paused blocks ordinary deposits and exits, including claims.

totalAssets includes idle CVX, Convex staked CVX and CLever strategy net assets after debt, repayment fee, fee-adjusted realized rewards and pending unlock obligations; it is not a cash-balance guarantee. Ordinary methods have no caller-set output minimum, max-input or deadline. CLever/Convex dependencies, rounding, mutable configuration and limited cash can affect execution.

No KYC proof/allowlist gate appears in these ordinary afCVX methods, but website terms require adult capacity and exclude US persons (including specified US residency/control connections), sanctioned/embargoed persons and unlawful jurisdictions. Contract ABI availability is not legal eligibility. uCVX/pxCVX migration, bridge, operator harvesting/distribution, governance and arbitrary zap execution are outside scope.

# Staking Guide

**Depositing**

Users can deposit and mint afCVX using three assets, with more to follow.

* CVX: Minting afCVX is easily done in a single click using CVX. Simply type in the amount you wish to deposit, and press Deposit. Now sit back and relax and let the yield roll in! Note that cost to stake is quite low because the background contract interactions are batched and executed on a daily basis.
* uCVX & pxCVX: Minting afCVX with uCVX or pxCVX is a two step process that requires time to elapse. Users will first enter the amount of uCVX or pxCVX they wish to migrate to afCVX and press Deposit. Users will be given a date at which they can return to claim their afCVX in the Claim tab. Users can return at that date and simply press Claim to receive their afCVX. Now sit back and relax and let the yield roll in! 

**Withdrawing**

There are two ways to withdraw and redeem afCVX for CVX.

a) Instant Unstake - 3% Fee.

* Users selecting this option will receive CVX instantly. There is a 3% fee associated with instant unstaking in order to prevent gamification of the system. This fee is immediately sent directly back into afCVX, so the withdrawers' loss is everyone else's gain!
* Every week, 25% of the available liquid stkCVX within afCVX is available to users to withdraw from. This restriction is in place to give the protocol time to rebalance in the event of large withdrawals, as well as guard against bad actors, and is subject to change.

b) Regular Unstake - Zero Fee

* Users selecting this option will then be given a date that they can come back to claim their unlocked CVX for zero fee.

Regular unstake uses a rolling queue system where users are given a date at which their CVX is unlocked and available to claim. Users will be given the first available date at no additional cost.
